title: Output envelope
description: What `plan.py --output json <verb>` prints: exactly one success or one error object. Every verb uses it; the CLI validates it before printing.

oneOf.description: Success: `data` is the verb result (a JSON document for show/context/brief/next, `{"message": text}` for verbs that only print a line).

data.description: Verb result; its shape is the verb's own contract.

oneOf.description: Refusal: a stable `code`, an English message and optional per-document issues.

code.description: Stable upper-case refusal code, for example REF_UNKNOWN or USAGE.

issues.description: Per-document validation issues behind the refusal, when there are any.
